choices.question: What is a clone?
answers:
A copy of a character made while playing.

The background picture of the game

Any enemy that appears more than once in a game

choices.question: Which of these is not a natural example of a fractal?
Which of these is not an object in the same class?
What is a parent/primary sprite?
answers:
The original that is cloned from

The sprite with the largest size

The sprite at the end of the game after the player loses or wins

choices.question: Which loop do we use to create an infinite number of clones?
Why do we delete clones once they are created
answers:
To preserve memory and prevent lag

To stop the score from reaching infinity

To stop the game from becoming too difficult
